title: Docker and CI workflows
text: common practice separate build image (compilers -dev headers) runtime image (runtime libraries). keeps deployed image small. sysreqr::dockerfile() produces build-stage block. runtime block, uses non--dev variants, manual mirror.
code: # ---- Stage 1: build ---- FROM rocker/r-ver:4.4 AS build  # System build deps (compilers and headers) RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \     libxml2-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev \     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*  COPY . /src WORKDIR /src RUN R -e 'install.packages(c("xml2", "curl"))'  # ---- Stage 2: runtime ---- FROM rocker/r-ver:4.4  # Runtime libraries only (note: no -dev suffix) RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \     libxml2 libcurl4 libssl3 \     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*  COPY --from=build /usr/local/lib/R/site-library /usr/local/lib/R/site-library COPY --from=build /src /app WORKDIR /app CMD ["R", "--no-save"]

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: First public release.

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: check_packages() resolves system packages R package needs given Linux platform. Four backends available: "auto" (default), "bundled", "ppm", "pak". check_library() audits installed packages R library path. check_project() detect_project_packages() scan project directory, preferring renv.lock, DESCRIPTION, source files.

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: detect_platform() reads /etc/os-release Linux, sw_vers macOS, parses fixture files tests. detect_package_manager() returns package manager platform (apt, dnf, yum, zypper, apk, brew). resolve_platform() accepts NULL, existing platform object, <distro>-<version> shorthand, codename alias (jammy, noble, resolute, bookworm, trixie).

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: install_command() generates platform-appropriate install commands. dockerfile() write_dockerfile_snippet() produce Dockerfile snippets. github_actions() (alias gha()) produces GitHub Actions YAML step. admin_request() drafts plain-text request system administrators. write_install_script() writes POSIX shell script. write_report() write_json() persist plan disk. as_install_plan() returns structured list suitable downstream tooling.

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: diagnose_log() (alias diagnose_install_log()) matches common compiler linker error patterns resolves failed package names back system requirements. check_error() convenience wrapper reads geterrmessage(). diagnose_failed_packages() resolves known list failed R packages.

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
text: ppm_platforms(), check_ppm(), ppm_repo(), ppm_sysreqs(), use_ppm() integrate Posit Package Manager API binary repository URLs.

title: sysreqr 0.1.0
